hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/cunningham.aspx ('106 basic sites and 36 electric sites') + parkreservations.maryland.gov per-site catalog for parkId 380105 (the 34 Houck-area electric sites in Addison Run, Catoctin Creek and Deer Spring loops list Electrical Service 30 amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: William Houck Campground: 106 basic and 36 electric sites (DNR), each a 23 x 23 ft stone-dust pad; the booking site lists 138 in five loops (Addison Run, Bear Branch, Catoctin Creek, Deer Spring Branch, Elderberry), almost all with a 30-ft max vehicle length. The park's separate Manor Area Campground (sites M1-M31, open year-round) books under the same park.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/cunningham.aspx (William Houck Campground features) + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/cunningham-falls-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380105 (site list and each site's details page), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/cunningham.aspx ('Centrally located bathhouses in each loop', 'Dump Station at Campground Exit', 'Potable water spigot available in each camping loop') + the booking page's amenities (Showers, Dump Station), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The booking page: campsites 'must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.' Check in at the Camp Office from 3 p.m.; pre-registered campers can self check-in after hours.

summary: Confirmed fees on the booking table ($21.50/$27.50 electric, +$1 weekends), the inherited 365-day window, and the April-October season (already manual). Added 30-amp electric, 142 Houck sites (23x23 ft pads, 30-ft max vehicle), showers, water spigots, dump, booking closes 1 day before arrival. Not stated: water/sewer at sites, min/max stay for this park, fcfs.
